extracted.name: Crab Legs with Garlic Butter Sauce
extracted.description: This crab legs recipe couldn't be easier! Don't pay marked-up restaurant prices when you can make crab legs in a tasty butter sauce at home for much less.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound Snow Crab clusters, thawed if necessary
instruction_lines: Cut a slit, length-wise, into the shell of each piece of crab.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add garlic and cook until translucent, 1 to 2 minutes. Stir in parsley, pepper, and salt. Continue to heat mixture until bubbling.
Add crab legs to the skillet; toss to coat with butter mixture. Simmer until completely heated through, 5 to 6 minutes.
